caption:
Myth: you have to answer SAT questions in order.

Inside a module you can skip, mark questions for review, and change answers until time runs out. Once you leave a module, you can't go back.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: You don't have to answer SAT questions in order. Skip, flag, come back.

youtube.title: SAT Myth: You Have to Answer in Order
youtube.description: On the digital SAT you can move around within a module, mark questions for review, and change answers until time runs out, but you can't return to a finished module.
